title: Leeds United Lineup Builder
text:
Summer 2026

Pick your Leeds United starting XI from the current squad, choose a formation, then download the image or share it.

Two ways to pick: tap a player then tap a position, or tap an empty position first and then choose from the squad list. On a computer you can also drag a player onto a position. Tap a filled position to clear it.

https://leedsinsandouts.com/lineup

23 players available. Selected players are dimmed.

Windows: 18 recorded. Squad shown is the current window.

LEEDS INS & OUTS - The Leeds United data archive. Current squad, transfers, rumours, results and 100+ years of Leeds history.

An independent Leeds United fan archive. Not affiliated with Leeds United FC.

Data & sources explains how the site updates and how fees are labelled. Browse the player index or search the archive.
